phrases.arabic: يَا أَللهُ الَّذِي لاَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ
phrases.english: 1.O God, from whom nothing is concealed

phrases.arabic: شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ،
phrases.english: 2.in earth or heaven!

phrases.arabic: وَكَيْفَ يَخْفى عَلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي  مَا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهُ؟
phrases.english: 3.How should what You hast created, my God, be concealed from You?

phrases.arabic: وَكَيْفَ لاَ تُحْصِي مَا أَنْتَ صَنَعْتَهُ؟
phrases.english: 4.How shouldst You not number what You hast made?

phrases.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَغِيبُ عَنْكَ مَا أَنْتَ تُدَبِّرُهُ؟
phrases.english: 5.How should what You governest be absent from You?

phrases.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَهْرُبَ مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ حَياةَ لَهُ إلاَّ بِرِزْقِكَ؟
phrases.english: 6.How should one who has no life except through Your provision have the ability to flee from You?

phrases.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَنْجُو مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ مَذْهَبَ لَهُ فِي غَيْرِ مُلْكِكَ؟
phrases.english: 7.How should one who has no road except in Your kingdom escape from You?

phrases.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! أَخْشى خَلْقِكَ لَكَ أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِكَ،
phrases.english: 8.Glory be to You! He among Your creatures who fears You most knows You best,

phrases.arabic: وَأَخْضَعُهُمْ لَكَ أَعْمَلُهُمْ بِطَاعَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 9.he among them most bent in humility is most active in obeying You,

phrases.arabic: وَأَهْوَنُهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مَنْ أَنْتَ تَرْزُقُهُ وَهُوَ يَعْبُدُ غَيْرَكَ،
phrases.english: 10.and he among them whom You providest while he worships another is most contemptible before You!

phrases.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! لاَ يُنْقِصُ سُلْطَانَكَ مَنْ أَشْرَكَ بِكَ، وَكَذَّبَ رُسُلَكَ،
phrases.english: 11.Glory be to You! He who associates others with You and denies Your messengers diminishes not Your authority.

phrases.arabic: وَلَيْسَ يَسْتَطِيعُ مَنْ كَرِهَ قَضَآءَكَ أَنْ يَرُدَّ أَمْرَكَ،
phrases.english: 12.He who dislikes Your decree cannot reject Your command.

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يَمْتَنِعُ مِنْكَ مَنْ  كَذَّبَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 13.He who denies Your power keeps himself not away from You.

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يَفُوتُكَ مَنْ عَبَدَ غَيْرَكَ،
phrases.english: 14.He who worships other than You escapes You not.

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يُعَمَّرُ فِي الدُّنْيَا مَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَآءَكَ.
phrases.english: 15.He who dislikes meeting You will not be given endless life in this world.

phrases.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ!  مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ، وَأَقْهَرَ سُلْطَانَكَ،
phrases.english: 16.Glory be to You! How mighty is Your station, overpowering Your authority,

phrases.arabic: وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّتَكَ، وَأَنْفَذَ أَمْرَكَ!
phrases.english: 17.intense Your strength, penetrating Your command!

phrases.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! قَضَيْتَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ الْمَوْتَ:
phrases.english: 18.Glory be to You! You hast decreed death for all Your creatures,

phrases.arabic: مَنْ وَحَّدَكَ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ بِكَ،
phrases.english: 19.both him who professes Your Unity and him who disbelieves in You;

phrases.arabic: وَكُلٌّ ذَائِقُ المَوْتِ،
phrases.english: 20.each one will taste death,

phrases.arabic: وَكُلٌّ صَائِرٌ إلَيْكَ، فَتَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ،
phrases.english: 21.each one will come home to You. Blessed art You and high exalted!

phrases.arabic: لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكَ،
phrases.english: 22.There is no god but Thou, You alone, who hast no associate. I have faith in You,

phrases.arabic: وَصَدَّقْتُ رُسُلَكَ وَقَبِلْتُ كِتَابَكَ،
phrases.english: 23.I attest to Your messengers, I accept Your Book,

phrases.arabic: وَكَفَرْتُ بِكُلِّ مَعْبُود غَيْرِكَ،
phrases.english: 24.I disbelieve in every object of worship other than You,

phrases.arabic: وَبَرِئْتُ مِمَّنْ عَبَدَ سِوَاكَ.
phrases.english: 25.I am quit of anyone who worships another!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أُصْبحُ وَأُمْسِي مُسْتَقِلاًّ لِعَمَلِي،
phrases.english: 26.O God, I rise in the morning and enter the evening making little of my good works,

phrases.arabic: مُعْتَرِفاً بِذَنْبِي، مُقِرَّاً بِخَطَايَايَ،
phrases.english: 27.confessing my sins, admitting my offenses;

phrases.arabic: أَنَا بِإسْرَافِي عَلَى نَفْسِي ذَلِيلٌ،
phrases.english: 28.I am abased because of my prodigality against myself.

phrases.arabic: عَمَلِي أَهْلَكَنِي، وَهَوَايَ أَرْدَانِي،
phrases.english: 29.My works have destroyed me, my caprice has ruined me,

phrases.arabic: وَشَهَوَاتِي حَرَمَتْنِي.
phrases.english: 30.my passions have deprived me.

phrases.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ سُؤالَ مَنْ نَفْسُهُ لاَهِيَةٌ لِطُولِ أَمَلِهِ،
phrases.english: 31.So I ask You, my Master, the asking of him whose soul is diverted by his drawn out expectations,

phrases.arabic: وَبَدَنُهُ غَافِلٌ لِسُكُونِ عُرُوقِهِ،
phrases.english: 32.whose body is heedless because of the stillness of his veins,

phrases.arabic: وَقَلْبُهُ مَفْتُونٌ بِكَثْرَةِ النِّعَمِ عَلَيْهِ،
phrases.english: 33.whose heart is entranced by the multitude of favours done for him,

phrases.arabic: وَفِكْرُهُ قَلِيلٌ لِمَا هُوَ صَائِرٌ  إلَيْهِ،
phrases.english: 34.whose reflection is little concerning that to which he is coming home;

phrases.arabic: سُؤَالَ مَنْ قَدْ غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الاَمَلُ،
phrases.english: 35.the asking of him whom false expectation has overcome,

phrases.arabic: وَفَتَنَهُ الْهَوى، وَاسْتَمْكَنَتْ مِنْهُ الدُّنْيَا،
phrases.english: 36.caprice has entranced, and this world has mastered,

phrases.arabic: وَأَظَلَّهُ الاَجَلُ، سُؤَالَ مَنِ اسْتَكْثَرَ ذُنُوبَهُ،
phrases.english: 37.and over whom death has cast its shadow; the asking of him who makes much of his sins

phrases.arabic: وَاعْتَرَفَ بِخَطِيئَتِهِ، سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ رَبَّ لَهُ غَيْرُكَ،
phrases.english: 38.and confesses his offense; the asking of him who has no Lord but Thou,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ وَلِيَّ لَهُ دُونَكَ، وَلاَ مُنْقِذَ لَهُ مِنْكَ،
phrases.english: 39.no friend besides You, no one to deliver him from You,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ مَلْجَأَ لَهُ مِنْكَ إلاَّ إلَيْكَ .
phrases.english: 40.and no asylum from You except in You.

phrases.arabic: إلهِي أسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْـوَاجِبِ عَلَى  جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ،
phrases.english: 41.My God, I ask You by Your right incumbent upon all Your creatures,

phrases.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَ رَسُولَكَ أَنْ يُسَبِّحَكَ بِهِ،
phrases.english: 42.by Your mighty name with which You commanded Your messenger to glorify You,

phrases.arabic: وَبِجَلاَلِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ الذِي لاَ يَبْلى
phrases.english: 43.and by the majesty of Your generous face, which ages not,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يَتَغَيَّرُ، وَلاَ يَحُولُ وَلاَ يَفْنى،
phrases.english: 44.nor changes, nor alters, nor passes away,

phrases.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
phrases.english: 45.that You blessest Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْ تُغْنِيَنِي عَنْ كُلِّ شَيْء بِعِبادَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 46.that You freest me from need for all things through worshipping You,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْ تُسَلِّيَ نَفْسِيْ عَنِ الدُّنْيَا بِمَخَافَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 47.that You distractest my soul from this world through fear of You,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْ تُثْنِيَنِي بِالْكَثِيْرِ  مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 48.and that You turnest me back toward Your abundant generosity through Your mercy!

phrases.arabic: فَإلَيْكَ أَفِرُّ، و مِنْكَ أَخَافُ، وَبِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ،
phrases.english: 49.To You I flee, You I fear, from You I seek aid,

phrases.arabic: وَإيَّاكَ أَرْجُو، وَلَكَ أَدْعُو، وَإلَيْكَ أَلْجَأُ،
phrases.english: 50.in You I hope, You I supplicate, in You I seek asylum,

phrases.arabic: وَبِكَ أَثِقُ، وَإيَّاكَ أَسْتَعِينُ، وَبِكَ أُؤمِنُ،
phrases.english: 51.in You I trust, from You I ask help, in You I have faith,

phrases.arabic: وَعَلَيْكَ أَتَوَكَّلُ،
phrases.english: 52.in You I have placed my confidence,

phrases.arabic: وَعَلَى جُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ أَتَّكِلُ.
phrases.english: 53.and upon Your munificence and Your generosity I rely.
